caption:
Staring at the booking screen, wondering whether to pick 30, 45 or 60 minutes? Momo was too.

A quick guide: 30 minutes suits one focused area, like tight shoulders or post-run calves. 45 minutes works for two connected areas, such as neck and upper back. 60 minutes is useful for a first visit, several areas, or a heavy training block.

Longer isn't automatically better. The right length is usually the one you can book consistently, paired with movement and exercise between sessions. Not sure? Tell your therapist your goal.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio plan each session around you. Book online via the link in bio.
